compound.name: menthone
compound.one_liner: Second major peppermint oil constituent (14-32 %); the ketone that menthol is reduced from.

identity.note: PubChem record titled 'Menthone' carries the (2S,5R) (l-menthone) stereo.

occurrences.source_citation: EMA/HMPC. Assessment report on Mentha x piperita L., folium and aetheroleum, Rev. 1. EMA/HMPC/522409/2013 (15 Jan 2020). https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/herbal-report/assessment-report-mentha-x-piperita-l-folium-and-aetheroleum-revision-1_en.pdf
occurrences.database: Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases
occurrences.note: Duke: MENTHONE Leaf 310-12400 ppm; Plant 20-10000 ppm. Isomenthone 1.5-10 % is specified separately. | Basis as recorded: % of essential oil (Ph. Eur. range)

processing_stability.volatility: steam-volatile: recovered in hydro/steam-distilled essential oil (see occurrence sources)
processing_stability.note: Solubility and heat-stability values not sourced in this pass.

compound.teaching_note: Menthone and menthol sit next to each other in the pathway; the ratio shifts between oils, which is why Ph. Eur. specifies both ranges [6].
gaps: No human evidence for the isolated compound found in this pass.
Pathway step menthone→menthol stated without a biosynthesis source.
